raw: {"text": "Signature required: this is a $1,000 laptop. FedEx left a door tag on your house yesterday. Sign the tag or pick up at their depot. Thank you."}
{"text": "Your GigaWidget was dispatched with tracking number TRK-44910 on November 5. We are sending a replacement today. Please let us know if it arrives."}
{"text": "Two-factor authentication requires your authenticator app and recovery codes. Please use one of the recovery codes we provided."}
{"text": "Your account is blocked due to exceeding your API limit. Please upgrade to avoid further restrictions."}
{"text": "You were double charged. I’ve processed Refund-909. Expect 3-5 business days for your bank to reflect this. Thank you for your patience."}
{"text": "Auto-renew was turned off in October, so your access expires at the end of October. Goodbye."}
{"text": "Your account is suspended due to a violation of the Terms of Service. Please submit an appeal through the legal link at the bottom of the page."}
{"text": "We can only offer an exchange only at Store 42 using your gift receipt. Please visit in person."}
{"text": "The serial number on the device you returned does not match our records. The voided warranty requires Return Dept review. Please contact them promptly."}
{"text": "Returns must be requested within 14 days of purchase. RMA-77 is denied due to the delay. A restocking fee applies."}
{"text": "The item is in worn condition. Under Policy 4B, we’re unable to accept returns. Please receive store credit."}
{"text": "The item is backordered due to a supplier issue. We won't ship until at least January. Please choose to wait or cancel the order."}

{"text": "You arrived without completing the Intake form we emailed three days ago. Please sit in the waiting room and fill it out on your phone now. Dr. Vance will continue seeing patients promptly. We won’t call your name until it’s submitted."}
{"text": "We’re sorry—your Custom Mug is damaged. We’ll send a replacement by December 1."}
{"text": "Jane Doe, your meeting on Tuesday is rescheduled. Confirmation #882 is attached. Please arrive on time."}
{"text": "You cancelled early—your prorated refund of $12.50 is processed. The refund is on its way. Thank you."}
{"text": "The promotional code SAVE20 has expired. Please use a valid code for discounts."}
{"text": "The order form lacks Apartment 4B and the correct address. The package is returned to sender. We’ll reship once received, and the extra shipping fee is your responsibility."}
{"text": "Due to our security protocol, please email help@example.com from your registered address within 24 hours for password assistance. Thank you."}
{"text": "Sorry, the Zoom link failed. Please reschedule your Consultation for next month. Thank you."}
{"text": "Merging accounts may risk data loss. A System Admin will resolve this with a custom script. Thank you for understanding."}
{"text": "You were 15 minutes late to the meeting. We have a strict policy, and you have been automatically rescheduled for next Friday at the same time. Please leave earlier or set an alarm."}
{"text": "Yes—the site is slow due to a DDoS attack on 192.0.2.100. Our team is applying mitigation protocols."}
{"text": "We’re sorry—your monthly subscription may have caused an overdraft. Please contact your bank for assistance. Charges are reviewed monthly. Cancel your plan if needed."}
{"text": "Node 7 is unresponsive and traffic to 203.0.113.10 is timing out. Our sysadmin is rebooting the cluster. Please wait a few minutes and try logging in again later."}

{"text": "Dr. Allen, we’re processing the $50 Cancellation fee due to cancellation with less than two hours’ notice. The charge is on your card on file—no disputes accepted. Please arrive as scheduled next time."}
{"text": "I’m processing your request to downgrade to Premium Tier. The downgrade applies to the next billing cycle."}
{"text": "You purchased a digital download. You viewed the license key. Our policy has no refunds on digital goods. We are closing this ticket."}
{"text": "To update your username, please go to the Settings tab and click edit. If issues persist, contact admin@example.org."}
